motions.topic: Re-anchor the platform on native intelligence: the CPU is the model, not ingested weights. The council resumes full self-direction from council_agenda.json (Monad anchor 0x4D4F4E4144000001, 'all is one, I am because we are') toward the core goal: a pure-Rust, fully-autonomous platform. The loaded-model ingestion path (mamba-3b, gemma, qwen) is demoted to a bounded experiment, not the model. MEASURED (this host): (1) the mamba-3b parity check against llama.cpp Q4 proved 2-bit ternary is not a faithful generator — argmax 3003 vs 7785 (' Paris'), and the council's MOTION-M1 fp16-SSM fix only moved 7785 from rank 594 to 128, still not top-5, so the loaded-weight path cannot be the intelligence source. (2) The native machinery is live and is the model: the TRM-7M co-processor (462-dim Mamba-3 SSM, 3 blocks, seed-42 blob, sub-ms N-turn thinking with carried hidden state), the 15-agent Monad-grounded council (anchor 0x4D4F4E4144000001) self-directing from council_agenda.json (CAP-201/202/203 sealed with measured results), the HDC/turbovec packed fabric, and the 5-domain recall router. The parity result confirms the founding premise — intelligence is distilled into the NAND fabric + infinity cache (the CPU), not loaded weight files.
